decisions.before: Ruling REQ-021 (Q-13): the expand icon opens the album selection screen.
decisions.after: Ruling REQ-021 (Q-13) 「上面expand會打開相簿選擇畫面」: the expand at the top (album name ▼) opens the album selection screen; row corrected by REQ-023 (it had read the ruling as the tile icon). No source says what the tile icon opens: Step 3 follows the build (R3, R4).

summary: TC-151 / R-233 follow the Q-13 ruling as the user meant it (REQ-023, 2026-11-20): 「上面expand」 is the album name ▼ at the top; the tile icon opens the photo viewer.
